sourcePolicy: Original exam-style practice, except dated current-affairs items with source links; none are represented as official PYQs.

questions.q: Which date marks Meghalaya Statehood Day?
questions.e: Meghalaya became an autonomous state within Assam in 1970 and attained full statehood on 21 January 1972.

questions.q: The Wangala harvest festival is most closely associated with which community?
questions.e: Wangala is a major post-harvest thanksgiving festival of the Garo people, featuring traditional drums and dance.

questions.q: Which Schedule provides for autonomous district councils in tribal areas of Meghalaya?
questions.e: The Sixth Schedule provides for autonomous district and regional councils in specified tribal areas of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram.

questions.q: The Dandi March of 1930 directly challenged British laws concerning which commodity?
questions.e: The march challenged British salt laws and the salt tax and became a key event in the Civil Disobedience Movement.

questions.q: In which year was the Indian National Congress founded?
questions.e: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885; its first session was held in Bombay under W. C. Bonnerjee.

questions.q: Which Article guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws?
questions.e: Article 14 guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws. It is part of Part III, Fundamental Rights.

questions.q: Directive Principles of State Policy are found in which Part of the Constitution?
questions.e: Part IV, Articles 36–51, contains the Directive Principles of State Policy.

questions.q: Who appoints the Governor of an Indian state?
o: Chief Justice of the High Court
questions.e: Under Article 155, the Governor of a state is appointed by the President of India.

questions.q: Which river is the longest river of Peninsular India?
questions.e: The Godavari is the longest river of Peninsular India and is often called the Dakshin Ganga.

questions.q: Which soil is traditionally associated with cotton cultivation and high clay content?
questions.e: Black or regur soil has high clay content and good moisture retention, making it suitable for cotton in many regions.

questions.q: In which year did the Reserve Bank of India begin operations?
questions.e: The RBI began operations on 1 April 1935; it was nationalised in 1949.

questions.q: GST is generally described as which type of tax?
o: A tax only on personal income
questions.e: GST is designed as a destination-based tax on consumption, subject to the statutory framework.

questions.q: Which sentence correctly uses the singular subject 'each'?
questions.e: 'Each' is singular in this construction, so it takes the singular verb 'has'.

questions.q: Choose the closest synonym of 'meticulous'.
questions.e: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail; precise and very careful is the closest meaning.

questions.q: Find 18% of 750.
questions.e: Formula: (percentage ÷ 100) × total = (18/100) × 750 = 135. Shortcut: 10% is 75 and 8% is 60; total is 135.

questions.q: A total of 144 is divided in the ratio 5:7. What is the larger share?
questions.e: Total parts = 5 + 7 = 12. One part = 144 ÷ 12 = 12. Larger share = 7 × 12 = 84. Check: 60 + 84 = 144.

questions.q: Calculate simple interest on ₹15,000 at 8% per annum for 2 years.
A finishes a job in 20 days and B in 30 days. How long do they take together at constant rates?
questions.e: A's rate is 1/20 job/day and B's is 1/30. Combined rate = 1/20 + 1/30 = 1/12 job/day, so the job takes 12 days.
questions.source: Original exam-style practice; time and work

questions.q: What comes next: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, __?
questions.e: The differences are +5, +7, +9 and +11; the next difference is +13. Therefore 35 + 13 = 48.

questions.q: A is the sister of B. B is the father of C. How is A related to C?
questions.e: B is C's father and A is B's sister; therefore A is C's paternal aunt.

questions.q: Which named SI unit is used to express force in mechanics?
questions.e: Force is measured in newtons (N). From F = ma, one newton accelerates a 1 kg mass at 1 m/s².

questions.q: Which pigment in green plants absorbs light for photosynthesis?
questions.e: Chlorophyll in chloroplasts absorbs light energy used in photosynthesis.

questions.q: A solution with pH 2 is generally:
questions.e: At introductory level, pH below 7 is acidic, 7 is neutral and above 7 is alkaline.

questions.q: The Ramsar Convention focuses on conservation and wise use of what?
questions.e: The Ramsar Convention is an international treaty concerned with wetlands and their conservation and wise use.

questions.q: The ozone layer is concentrated mainly in which atmospheric layer?
questions.e: The ozone layer is concentrated mainly in the stratosphere and absorbs much harmful ultraviolet radiation.

questions.q: What does CPU stand for?
questions.e: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit; it executes instructions and coordinates core processing operations.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution provides for the GST Council?
questions.e: Article 279A provides for the GST Council, which makes recommendations on important GST matters.

questions.q: What is the basic purpose of eligible Input Tax Credit under GST?
o: Credit eligible GST paid on qualifying business inputs against output tax, subject to conditions
Automatic refund of every tax payment
questions.e: ITC permits eligible GST paid on qualifying inputs or input services to be credited against output tax liability, subject to statutory conditions, documentation and restrictions.
questions.source: Original exam-style practice; input tax credit

questions.q: According to the latest extension notice visible on the CEO Meghalaya website on 10 October 2026, what date is listed for publication of the final electoral roll under SIR 2026?
questions.e: The CEO Meghalaya website's latest extension notice lists 26 October 2026, replacing 21 October. Electoral schedules can change, so check the official page again before an exam.
questions.source: Current-affairs practice; CEO Meghalaya notice checked 10 October 2026

questions.q: A Meghalaya government release listed on 7 October 2026 reported preparations at Garo Heritage Village, Chibragre, for the Golden Jubilee celebration of which festival?
questions.e: The Meghalaya IPR release listing dated 7 October 2026 mentions preparations for the Golden Jubilee celebration of the 100 Drums Wangala Festival at Garo Heritage Village, Chibragre.
questions.source: Current-affairs practice; Meghalaya IPR release listing, 7 October 2026

questions.q: A news report published on 6 October 2026 described a Meghalaya workshop on the Integrated Kaushal Rural Portal under which programme?
questions.e: The report described a workshop under Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) 2.0, focusing on rural youth training, placement outcomes and employment tracking. This item relies on a secondary news source.
questions.source: Current-affairs practice; Times of India report, 6 October 2026 (secondary source)
